title: Wireless Headphones & AR Glasses
teaser: Product design and engineering for the world's first truly wireless smart earphones.
headline: Early product engineering for a wearable category that had to feel credible before the market was obvious.
challenge: The Dash needed product and engineering clarity around miniaturized hardware, sensors, and a new consumer interaction model.
outcome: Ali contributed product design and engineering support to a hearables product that translated 27 sensors and $3.3M+ in funding momentum into a tangible hardware story.
bullets: Supported product design and engineering for one of the first truly wireless smart earphone products.
Worked in a hardware startup context where sensor density, physical form, and user experience had to move together.
Helped frame a complex wearable system as a credible consumer product category.
